{{Infobox league |name=CTF Showdown 2 |image=Showdown_2.png |series= |organizer={{player|Shining|flag=se}} |admin={{player|Elguapo|flag=se}}, {{player|Velocity|flag=se}}, {{player|Creature|flag=fi}} |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 |prizepool=Glory |date=5 Dec and 12 Dec, 2022 |year=2022 |website= |discord=discord.gg/7PdsweWA |twitch= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= |map1= Mammoth |map2= QWRCTF1 |map3= CTF8 |map4= E2M2 |map5= CTF2M8 |map6= |map7= }} We are now excited to present the second edition of CTF Showdown. This tournament will be a two-day thriller, offering everything that was captured during [https://www.quakeworld.nu/wiki/CTF_Showdown CTF Showdown] in May - but over two nights which hopefully should add an extra dimension to the tournament. == Format == * '''General Information''' ** 10 min rounds ** 4on4 (3on3 if one team can´t get a full squad or a stand-in that is accepted by the other team). * '''Group stage, GO3:''' 5 Dec, 2022 ** '''Maps:''' The procedure is "pick (team 1) - pick (team 2) - drop (team 2) - drop (team 1) - play". ** The team that wins "/cmd rnd team1 team2" picks first. ** Standings determined by won games, followed by won rounds followed by total frag difference. * '''Semifinals, BO3:''' 12 Dec, 2022 ** The top 4 teams go into the playoffs. ** '''Maps:''' The procedure is "pick (team 1) - pick (team 2) - drop (team 2) - drop (team 1) - play". ** Highest seeded team decides if to pick first or second. ** The first team to win 2 maps wins. * '''Grand Final, BO5:''' 12 Dec, 2022 ** '''Maps:''' The procedure is "pick (team 1) - pick (team 2) - pick (team 2) - pick (team 1) - play". ** Highest seeded team decides if to pick first or second. ** The first team to win 3 maps wins. '''Team colors:''' Due to the fact that some maps have uneven bases, the clan that did not select the map will be able to decide which team they would like to play (red or blue). In the last map, the team with the best frag difference will pick base. == Maps == {{Maps |title= |map1=Mammoth |map2=QWRCTF1 |map3=CTF8 |map4=E2M2 |map5=CTF2M8 }} == Group stage, GO3 == All info in [https://discord.gg/uaMKvnDpwz CTF Discord]. *'''How to get started with CTF''' ** Bind the hook with +fire 22 , or impulse 22 (bind q +fire 22) for example. ** Bind tossrune, to throw away your current rune: (bind r tossrune) for example. ** Practice your hook skills and config on a KTX-server. For example: connect london.badplace.eu:28503, in the console, type: ctf, then type: practice. ** The map [[Mammoth]] by {{player|alice|flag=se}} and QWRCTF1 by Infiniti are at the moment only available on de.aye.wtf:27501. == Trailer == {{#ev:youtube|O_7mRtqnjL4|580}} __NOTOC__
